§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
This chapter introduces the Steam Singularity Entangler, Dense State Steam Manipulator, Critical Entangled Singularity Stabilizer, and Singularity Drilling Hub. The manipulator processes steam fluid grades; the stabilizer uses dense steam to produce critical singularities. Check machine information for inputs and costs. Mark this chapter complete manually.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Distinguish steam fluids from singularity items: densification changes fluid grade, while entangling and stabilizing equipment produce singularities. Record inputs, products, and outlets separately so compressed fluid is not mistaken for a singularity. The drilling hub additionally needs its own node configuration; finishing earlier chapters does not establish that its network is ready.
